name: nudge-keys-we
description: The number pad's nudge and turn keys not covered by edge-group-nudge (KP_6, KP_9) and doodad-turn-we (KP_Divide): each object of edge-last-step.w3m box selected alone (tree LTlt and pathless LPcr in d, footman and farm hhou in u), then KP_8, KP_4, KP_2, KP_2, KP_7, KP_1, KP_3, KP_Multiply, KP_Multiply: the step is the object's (tree and farm 64, LPcr and footman 8), a diagonal moves both axes the whole step, KP_Multiply turns 5 degrees right (TESTING 'Moving objects at the edges', nudge-turn-we; this spec makes that a check, branch we-compare-9). Studio: selectionkeys.ts, doodadedit.ts GRID_NUDGE_STEPS. Num Lock set on by the spec

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__key = async (k, code) => { const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: k, code, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 40)); }; window.__keys = async () => { for (const [k, code] of [['8', 'Numpad8'], ['4', 'Numpad4'], ['2', 'Numpad2'], ['2', 'Numpad2'], ['7', 'Numpad7'], ['1', 'Numpad1'], ['3', 'Numpad3'], ['*', 'NumpadMultiply'], ['*', 'NumpadMultiply']]) await __key(k, code); };
